items.title: Track reopened on flood-damaged Galchhi-Betrawati road
items.summary: Kathmandu, October 1 A track has been opened along the Galchhi-Betrawati road section damaged by the Rasuwa floods. Infrastructure Minister Sunil Lamsal said public movement along the road section has resumed following the opening of the track. items.title: Nepal flood survivors are leaving temporary camps as government delays rehabilitation
items.summary: Most displaced families have moved into rented rooms or elsewhere as makeshift shelters become uninhabitable and the government delays resettlement and promised financial assistance.
